room_rent.display: Per day room rent plan opted
room_rent.note: Room rent is based on a per-day limit chosen at inception; proportionate deduction applies if higher room is taken. Actual limit amounts not specified in wording.

icu.note: Policy states ICU expenses paid up to actual ICU expenses provided by hospital.

copayment.display: 15%/20%/25% on claim amount exceeding 100x room rent limit
copayment.note: Co-pay applies on the portion of a claim exceeding 100 times the opted per-day room rent limit; percentage (15%/20%/25%) is chosen at inception. Also proportionate co-pay if room category exceeds opted limit.

sub_limits.display: Many sub-limits: specific diseases & modern treatments capped at 100x room rent
sub_limits.note: Listed conditions (cataracts, hernia, piles, joint replacement, etc.) and modern treatments capped at 100 times per-day room rent per claim. Joint replacement/vertebral surgery have 36-month wait plus same cap.

deductible.display: Not specified (aggregate or per-claim deductible as per schedule)
deductible.note: Policy mentions deductible concept and that it applies per year or per claim as specified in schedule, but no fixed amount stated in wording.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; waived for accidents and if continuously covered for 12+ months.

ped_waiting.note: 36 months continuous coverage from first policy inception; reducible via portability credit.

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24-month wait for listed conditions (cataracts, hernia, piles, fistula, etc.); 36 months for joint replacement, vertebral surgery, deviated nasal septum, congenital internal diseases, refractive error ≥7.5D.

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard exclusion (Excl18); only ectopic pregnancy is covered.

cumulative_bonus.note: Cumulative bonus is defined in the policy but no rate or maximum percentage is stated in the wording.

restoration.note: No restoration/reinstatement benefit mentioned in the policy wording.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 60 days prior to admission.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 90 days after discharge.

day_care.note: Indicative list of 399 procedures in Annexure I; any other procedure requiring <24 hrs due to technological advances also covered.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation is defined but not listed as a covered benefit under Section C.

ayush.note: AYUSH treatment covered; AYUSH hospital and day care centre definitions included. No separate sub-limit stated.

organ_donor.note: No organ donor expense benefit mentioned in the policy wording.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered up to ₹5,000 per hospitalisation for emergency transfer; also covers transfer to higher-facility hospital.

modern_treatments.note: 12 modern treatments listed in Annexure III (robotic surgery, stereotactic radiosurgery, oral chemo, etc.) covered but capped at 100 times per-day room rent per claim.

consumables.note: Extensive list of non-medical/consumable items excluded (Annexure II). Medicines and drugs during hospitalisation are covered under C1(vii) but standard consumables like gloves, masks, etc. are excluded.

global_cover.note: Policy explicitly covers treatment in India only; overseas treatment excluded.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage no claim can be contested except for proven fraud and permanent exclusions.

grace_period.note: 30 days for all modes except monthly premium where it is 15 days.

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only; not on renewals or portability.

portability.note: IRDAI portability norms apply; must apply at least 30 days before renewal.

notable_exclusions.display: No overseas treatment, no maternity, no domiciliary, no organ donor, no restoration, congenital external anomalies, growth hormone therapy, terrorism covered

optional_riders.display: Co-pay level selection (15%/20%/25%), per-day room rent plan selection; no other riders specified in wording
